translations.mapping_caveat: A missing causal-use result is a measurement gap, not automatically a new substrate node.

obligate_partners.partner: Task/context representation with a consequential policy reader
obligate_partners.ree_provider: CandidateRuleField; SD-033a/SD-082 compute_bias; E3 score-bias path
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: If rule content is irrelevant, matched content permutations leave bias/ranking unchanged.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: RL2 is a particular recurrent RL construction, not a requirement to add its reward objective or a new recurrent module.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: Permute rule-state content across matched contexts, preserve norm/gating and measure bias deltas and committed-class changes; held by GAP-B competence gate.

obligate_partners.partner: Variability source plus a pathway that can change actual choices
obligate_partners.ree_provider: MECH-313 NoiseFloor / MECH-260 StructuredCuriosity; MECH-440/441 injection-site build
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: A noise manipulation with no selection effect cannot demonstrate behavioural variability.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: LC-ACC experiments motivate checking functional influence; they do not validate additive noise, two independent knobs, or homology of REE modules.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: Hold amplitude/seed envelope fixed and permute state-conditioned curiosity content; record pre/post-score contributions and committed entropy. Unconditional noise is tested by controlled replacement, not a meaningless content shuffle.

obligate_partners.partner: Workspace content, access pathways and task-dependent readers
obligate_partners.ree_provider: Latent stack and registered loop/selection consumers; existing 723/723a readouts
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: Destroying task-relevant content should alter at least a downstream content-sensitive readout under non-degenerate exposure.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: GNW model roles are inspiration, not proof of consciousness or a demand for a literal cortical network.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: Shuffle latent samples within nuisance-matched groups; distinguish probe accuracy loss from actual consumer/choice loss.

obligate_partners.partner: Readout controls separating learned probe behaviour from representation content
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: A random/control-label task that predicts equally well undercuts interpretation of the probe.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: Selectivity controls do not establish causal use by the agent; this audit registers no claim that all desired controls have passed.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: Compare genuine versus shuffled content and control labels on held-out observations; native-consumer intervention remains separate.

obligate_partners.partner: Broadcast target gates and nonzero input for amplification
obligate_partners.ree_provider: BroadcastOverrideRegulator plus BLA/CeA/PAG/dACC consumers; SD-037 assembly-frontier validation
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: Multiplying a zero baseline cannot demonstrate override amplification; expose a nonzero consumer response first.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: The workspace simulation does not license REE threshold values or prove the biological mapping.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: Time-shuffle override at matched amplitude while measuring gated consumer deltas; do not interpret silence below threshold as missing code.

obligate_partners.partner: Initiation, persistent policy execution and termination signal
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: Without persistent identity and observable termination, a claimed commitment-duration effect can be an argmax segmentation artefact.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: Options formalism supplies a reference functional decomposition, not an import of an option library or reward semantics.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: Permute commitment content while preserving gate timing; measure program identity, termination events and action-class DV, not raw segment length alone.

obligate_partners.partner: Scored alternatives and a consequential reader of the diversity signal
obligate_partners.ree_provider: MECH-341 apply_entropy_bonus -> E3 scores / modulatory accumulator / LCG terms
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: An allegedly unused score bonus must leave scored alternatives invariant; the traced code contradicts that absence claim.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: A temporal-policy reference does not establish the correct entropy objective; only the producer-reader boundary transfers.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: Permute candidate-specific bonus content holding magnitude fixed; inspect score/rank and eventual committed-choice effects.

obligate_partners.partner: Task variation, adaptation state and an evaluation sensitive to the required timescale
obligate_partners.ree_provider: 606b across-episode task variation; SD-033a recurrent rule state; trained context discriminator
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: An evaluation varying tasks only across resets cannot adjudicate a within-episode switching signature.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: RL2 holds one sampled MDP fixed within a trial and carries state across episodes. It does NOT itself require within-episode switching; that obligation is MECH-318 own falsifier.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: Shuffle rule-state content after the prescribed switch while preserving state magnitude and event timing, once both instrument and independent competence gates are ready.

obligate_partners.partner: Within-episode switch event and switch-aligned adaptation-time measurement
obligate_partners.falsifiable_consequence: A trace must contain an actual in-episode rule transition, no agent reset at the transition and a computable adaptation latency; existing 606b cannot supply that trace.
obligate_partners.mapping_caveat: Necessity is grounded in the REE falsifier and code, not inferred as universal biology from RL2. No task-ID oracle, cross-episode persistence change or dedicated meta-RL module is selected.
obligate_partners.content_shuffle_check: As above; a no-switch control plus recurrent-state ablation must make the DV capable of differing. No experiment queued.
